settings.visus.chat_links_detail: Ctrl+click opens the other one. Sign-in pages always open in your default browser.
settings.visus.suggestions_detail: Off: suggestions come from your history and open tabs only. On: what you type is also sent to your search engine.
settings.visus.ask_new_site_row: Ask before a model uses a new site
settings.visus.ask_new_site_detail: A tab you share with a model always asks.
settings.visus.permissions_empty: No site has a saved answer. Choose "Always on this site" or "Block" in a prompt and it appears here.
settings.visus.ask_where_row: Ask where to save each file
settings.visus.clear_detail: Cookies, cache, site storage, history and saved answers of one profile. Choose which.
settings.visus.forget_detail: What the pages a model opened left behind, and the sites you always allowed it.
settings.visus.live_tabs_row: Keep at most N live tabs
settings.visus.live_tabs_detail: Other tabs show a snapshot until you open them.
settings.visus.clear_confirm_body: Cookies, cache, site storage, history and saved answers of one profile. Choose which. This cannot be undone.
settings.visus.forget_confirm_body: What the pages a model opened left behind, and the sites you always allowed it. This cannot be undone.
settings.tabula.live_detail: Off: models are not offered live views in chat.
settings.tabula.visual_detail: Fewer: only when you ask. Balanced: when it is clearly clearer than text. More: whenever numbers, options or plans are involved.
settings.tabula.html_detail: Small interactive pages in an answer. They run in a sandbox with no access to your chat, your files or the internet.
settings.tabula.apps_detail: Interactive views that MCP servers show in the chat.
settings.tabula.tiles_detail: Maps draw offline. A tile source adds streets, and then asks that site for the tiles in view, so it learns which area you look at.
settings.tabula.model_detail: An artifact's call to your model carries no chat history, tools or files.
settings.tabula.tiles_invalid: Use an https address with {0}, {1} and {2}, from a site on the internet.
settings.tabula.clear_confirm_body: Every version of every artifact in this thread is deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.shortcuts.toggle_browser_detail: Shows or hides the browser pane.
settings.shortcuts.toggle_side_chat_deta: Shows or hides a side conversation about this thread.
settings.shortcuts.toggle_artifacts_deta: Shows or hides the artifacts pane.
settings.shortcuts.toggle_background_tas: Shows or hides the list of running jobs.
settings.shortcuts.expand_pane_detail: Springs the focused pane over the workspace, or back.
settings.shortcuts.next_pane_detail: Moves focus to the next pane, then the dividers.
settings.shortcuts.previous_pane_detail: Moves focus to the previous pane.
settings.shortcuts.move_pane_earlier_det: Moves the focused pane one place earlier in the layout.
settings.shortcuts.move_pane_later_detai: Moves the focused pane one place later in the layout.
settings.shortcuts.join_pane_tabs_detail: Joins the focused pane to the one before it as a tab, or splits it out of its group.
